label: Hachiman system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses a Hachiman antiphage locus encoding a HamA/HamB core.
synonyms: Hachiman antiphage defense system|Hachiman defense system
observations: Replaces v96 METPO:1017300; family definition does not require universal DNA cleavage.

label: Hachiman type II system
definition: A Hachiman system in which an organism possesses a locus encoding HamA and HamB together with an additional HamC (DUF3223) component.
observations: HamABC architecture; heterologous defense is not native-host or universal mechanism evidence.
